mapper.select: SELECT A.ADDRESS_ID AS addressId, A.ADDRESS_ALIAS AS addressAlias, A.ZIPCODE AS zipcode, A.ADDRESS AS address, A.DETAILED_ADDRESS AS detailedAddress, A.DEFAULT_YN AS defaultYn, U.USER_NAME AS receiverName, U.USER_PHONE AS receiverPhone FROM USER_ADDRESS A INNER JOIN `USER` U ON A.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE A.DEFAULT_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, A.ADDRESS_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( ORDER_ID, AMOUNT, PAY_STATUS, PAID_AT ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{amount}, 'PAID', NOW() )

INSERT INTO order_item ( ORDER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, OPTION_ITEM_ID, QUANTITY, UNIT_PRICE, START_DATE, END_DATE ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{optionItemId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{rentalStart}, #{rentalEnd} )
mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID AS orderId, O.USER_ID AS userId, O.CART_IDS AS cartIds, O.USER_COUPON_ID AS userCouponId, O.ORDER_TYPE AS orderType, O.TOTAL_PRICE AS totalPrice, O.GUEST_NAME AS guestName, O.GUEST_PHONE AS guestPhone, ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID LIMIT 1 ) AS orderName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID ) AS itemCount FROM ORDERS O WHERE O.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_COUPON SET USED_YN = 'Y', USED_AT = NOW(), ORDER_ID = #{orderId}, STATUS = 'USED', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId} AND USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COUPON_USE_LOG ( USER_COUPON_ID, USER_ID, COUPON_ID, ORDER_ID, USED_AT, DISCOUNT_APPLIED_AMT ) SELECT #{userCouponId}, #{userId}, COUPON_ID, #{orderId}, NOW(), #{discountAmt} FROM USER_COUPON WHERE USER_COUPON_ID = #{userCouponId}
mapper.select: SELECT oi.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, oi.OPTION_ITEM_ID AS optionItemId, oi.QUANTITY AS quantity, oi.START_DATE AS startDate, oi.END_DATE AS endDate, o.ORDER_TYPE AS orderType FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID WHERE oi.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_HISTORY ( PAY_TYPE, NEW_STATUS, CHANGED_AT, TARGET_PAY_ID ) VALUES ( #{payType}, 'PAID', NOW(), #{payId} )

INSERT INTO rentals ( ITEM_ID, USER_ID, START_DATE, RETURN_DATE, RENTAL_STATUS, CREATED_AT, GUEST_NAME, GUEST_PHONE ) VALUES ( #{itemId}, #{userId}, #{startDate}, #{returnDate}, 'IN_USE', NOW(), #{guestName}, #{guestPhone} )
